focus: Upper Body Push & Lower Body Quadriceps (Progression)

exercises.name: Light Marching in Place
exercises.instructions: Position: Stand tall with shoulders back. Drive knees toward hip level alternately while swinging arms. Breath: Maintain continuous, rhythmic diaphragmatic breathing throughout (inhale through nose, exhale through mouth).

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instructions: Position: Stand upright with arms extended straight sideways at shoulder height. Rotate arms in small, controlled circles (30s forward, 30s backward). Breath: Inhale smoothly for 3 circles, exhale smoothly for 3 circles.

exercises.name: Gentle Torso Twists
exercises.instructions: Position: Stand with feet wider than hip-width, elbows bent near chest level. Rotate torso gently side to side, letting hips rotate slightly. Breath: Inhale as you cross center, exhale gently as you rotate to each side.

exercises.name: Incline Chair Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: Position: Hands on chair seat edge shoulder-width apart, body forming a straight line from crown to heels. Lower chest toward chair under control. Breath: Inhale slowly on the way down; exhale firmly through mouth as you push back up to starting position.

exercises.name: Chair Box Squats
exercises.instructions: Position: Feet shoulder-width apart facing away from chair, arms extended for balance. Hinge hips back and bend knees to tap chair lightly. Breath: Inhale deeply as you lower down; exhale forcefully through heels as you stand back up.

exercises.name: Mat Glute Bridges
exercises.instructions: Position: Lie on mat with knees bent at 90°, feet flat on floor, arms resting at sides. Drive through heels to lift hips toward ceiling. Breath: Exhale as you squeeze glutes and raise hips; inhale smoothly as you lower hips back to mat.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog Holds
exercises.instructions: Position: On mat in tabletop stance on hands and knees. Extend opposite arm straight forward and opposite leg straight back parallel to floor. Breath: Do not hold breath; take steady, shallow inhales and exhales while keeping core gently braced.

exercises.name: Standing Chest Opener Stretch
exercises.instructions: Position: Interlace fingers behind lower back, roll shoulders down and lift chest gently. Breath: Take deep, slow inhales into your chest cavity and exhale fully as muscles relax.

exercises.name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
exercises.instructions: Position: Stand tall near chair for balance, bend knee to hold ankle behind glutes. Breath: Maintain steady, deep breathing (inhale 4s, exhale 4s) throughout the hold.
